metadata.source: Bengaluru Municipal Corporation Public Events Dataset
metadata.disclaimer: This is synthetic demonstration data for Indian municipal FAQ chatbot evaluation. It does not represent actual BBMP, Karnataka government, or real municipal event operations.

records.title: Swachh Bengaluru Community Clean-Up & Recycling Drive
records.location: Cubbon Park Bandstand Pavilion, Kasturba Road, Bengaluru – 560001
records.organizer: BBMP Solid Waste Management Department & NSS Youth Volunteer Corps
records.description: City-wide Swachh Bharat community cleanup and recycling awareness campaign. Free segregated waste bins and composting kits distributed to participating households. Refreshments and participation certificates provided.
records.registration: No prior registration required; walk-ins welcome at BBMP registration tents.

records.title: Bengaluru Habba – Annual Heritage & Cultural Festival
records.location: Town Hall Grounds & Vidhana Soudha Lawns, Ambedkar Veedhi, Bengaluru – 560001
records.admission: Free general admission; premium concert seating available for ₹200
records.description: Four-day festival celebrating Karnataka and Bengaluru heritage, folk arts, regional culinary specialties, Yakshagana, classical dance (Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi), and live acoustic music. Over 80 artisanal food and craft stalls from across Karnataka.
records.registration: Free entry; stall bookings close September 30.

records.title: Ward 4 Janata Darbar – Citizen Town Hall & Public Hearing
records.location: Ward 4 Community Hall, 18 Indiranagar 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru – 560038
records.description: Open public forum (Janata Darbar) to discuss upcoming road improvement projects, stormwater drain (SWD) upgrades, and pedestrian safety initiatives. Citizens may submit oral questions or written petitions to BBMP ward engineers.

records.title: Hasiru Bengaluru – Urban Tree Plantation Drive
records.location: Ulsoor Lake Promenade & Sankey Tank Greenbelt, Bengaluru
records.admission: Free (Native saplings, digging tools, and gardening gloves provided)
records.description: Drive aiming to plant 2,000 native tree species (Rain Tree, Neem, Peepal, Gulmohar) along Bengaluru's lakebeds and arterial roads to improve air quality and prevent soil erosion. Citizens can sponsor and name a sapling.
records.registration: Pre-register on BBMP Citizens Portal or register on-site.

records.title: Free Preventive Health Camp & Vaccination Drive
records.location: BBMP Primary Health Centre, 77 CMC Compound, Jayanagar 4th Block, Bengaluru – 560041
records.organizer: BBMP Department of Public Health & Family Welfare
records.admission: Free for all BBMP ward residents
records.description: Complimentary health screenings including blood pressure, blood glucose, eye exams, pediatric health checks, and seasonal influenza, typhoid, and Hepatitis B vaccinations. Free generic medicines distributed on BBMP prescription.
records.registration: First-come, first-served; bring your Aadhaar Card and any existing health records.

records.title: E-Waste Nirmal Mela – Electronics Recycling Drive
records.location: BBMP Ward Eco-Centre, Koramangala 5th Block Open Ground, Bengaluru – 560095
records.organizer: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board & BBMP Certified Recyclers
records.admission: Free drop-off (Certificate of safe data destruction issued by certified agency)
records.description: Safe disposal mela for old computers, broken mobile phones, printers, televisions, cables, and home appliances. Citizens receive Swachh Vouchers redeemable at BBMP farmers' markets. Certified e-waste handlers ensure data security and responsible recycling.
records.registration: Walk-in drop-off available throughout event hours.
